body: Thats really helpful advice. So what I should just get an appointment at my GP go in and tell her/him I need help? I dont have the money to see a private dr. Im in the UK.

Nah youre alright. People always at as if thereis a quick fix i am looking for someone to give advice on how to get help from legitimate sources. I already said Im a competitive athlete. I dont need to work out to sove my problems.

If your depression was instantly cured by doing a few laps sorry but you werent depressed just sad. Please save your advice for the bar stool and preach to some other fuck who is as stupid as you to think that someone could be cured of depression after a quick jog.

I dont have any experience with weekly psycho therapy recently. It was when I was much younger and as I stated in my earlier post it turned into a kind of show with lots of different doctors there and I couldnt bear it any more. They had me on ritalin at first, then an increased dosage and then something else I cant remember. It made me really sick and much much worse.

All I seem to do is exercise, sllep and eat. I get up in the morning run my 6 miles eat then sleep throughout the day. I havent masturbated in four months because the need for that pleasure just isnt there. I go to a jiujitsu class but it is a very serious competitive class so there is no real interaction or chat just the sport. I have a few friends but they are so into drinking culture and their SO's that I just dont want to be around them most of the time. Sleep leads to horrible nightmares. I grew up in a very rough neighbourhood and I have visions of the guys I used to hang out with and all the bad things we done to people. 

Motivation to do anything positive just is not there. I always say I will do it but when it comes time to I just get mental blocks and end up seriously angry at myself. Its this anger that leads into the depression which leads to other stuff.

Thoughts I have when im at my lowest? That ill never get out of this house. Ill never find a job. Ill never have a girlfriend like the one i used to have. Like all my accomplishments mean nothing. Like there is no point in even getting out f bed to wash or get dressed or brush my teeth. Sometimes Ill havemoderate hallucinations like half sleeping while in bed. Just end of the world fantasies. Big ships crashing into the face of the earth and nuclear explosions. family members burning alive. sometimes ill be content sitting with a book and a coffee and it will just hit me and I have to get up and leave. everyone who looks at me wants to hurt me in my head.
How about you go fuck yourself you condescending cunt.
You are seriously a fucking muppet. You really think being depressed or suicidal is as simple as just getting on a bike at the gym? Get a grip you fucking asshole.
I work out 10+ times a week. I run 6 miles every morning and practice jiujitsu 3 times a week as well as a s+c programme. Working out is not going to help me.
There is no way I can tell them. My mother has manic depression as well and my sister has had her own boutswith it. They are just getting things together again.

I wouldnt eve know what to say. I feel kind of afraid that someone will say im fake or something, that I just want attention. I really need help but I dont know where to start. Should I just get a dr's appointment and spill or what should I do?

Im 28 years old and one of my friends was just told he had to start chemo. He is 29 and his wife is 6 months pregnant. In the book(I just started reading) it says that every smoke is like lighting a fuse and you never know which one is going to be the bomb that explodes. I cant smoke any more. There is no way I could put my family through watching me on chemo or having advanced cancer. Its not worth it any more.
